description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractCryptoClientV2` within the AWS SDK for PHP, related to cryptographic operations, including cipher support, encryption, and decryption streams. It sets a foundation for subclasses implementing specific cryptographic behaviors.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClientV2
classes.description: An abstract class providing cryptographic operations interface for AWS SDK, supporting cipher checking, encryption, and decryption stream creation.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported by the SDK.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OpenSSL cipher name based on cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a CipherMethod object for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Abstract method for reverse lookup to get OpenSSL cipher name from AES name.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create an encryption stream with provided plaintext, options, provider, and envelope.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create a decryption stream with cipher text and relevant metadata and provider.
